pages.text: B-Side causes the Gourmaryllis to develop a gambling addiction. So much so that it won't eat anything besides $(item)Suspicious Stew/$.$(br2)The same rule applies as normal, where eating a stew with the same effect and time as the previously eaten one will give diminishing returns. Longer streaks of variety give more mana.
The longer the effect of the stew, the more mana that will be generated, up to a certain point.$(br2)Many new stew recipes are available using various flowers.
